_comment: KV-2 - same TMFD-7 pattern as the KV-1, different gun entirely. The 152 mm M-10 is the slowest weapon in the roster, so its ladder covers a fraction of the range for the same screen travel: 1000 m sits where the KV-1's 2400 m would. That contrast is the point - it is what a howitzer in a turret should feel like to aim.
_optics: Mask / CommanderMask / Furniture are OPTIONAL. The aperture and every reticle line are drawn from geometry, so no art is required. If you add a PNG later, name it here and it is layered over the drawn mask; a path that does not resolve is skipped rather than painting the missing-texture magenta.
